name: Atheling Ancestry
body:
Grandpappy’s favorite saying; “Uton we sittan and nales don!”

Prerequisite(s): Human subtype

Benefit(s): You gain the Nostalgia and Suspicion racial traits, as outlined in the race description for Atheling.
